levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن شبوية المروزي

notes: three taḥwīl branches (ح) meet at al-Zuhri; the Zuhri written in branch 1 and branch 3 is each branch's own name, and the tail runs from Humayd to «أمه»
branch 2 («مسدد، حدثنا إسماعيل، ح») writes no name after إسماعيل before the next branch; the tail is applied to it as the convergence, which is a reading of the taḥwīl and not a name in the text
«- يعني ابن المديني -» style glosses are left out; «وقال أحمد بن محمد ومسدد ليس بالكاذب...» is a wording variant of the same saying and is left out (rule 4)
